title: Can I BEAT Martinfish?
summary: 'Martinfish evolves': Martinfish (child of Stockfish and Martin, built by wintrcat) plays a top engine move 95% of the time and a Martin move 5% of the time, randomly. Player (white, London System) tries to drag out a long symmetrical game waiting for Martin moves, but the bot builds a crushing queenside attack with a passed c-pawn; player is mated (Rc3+, king over, mate). Player is defeated.
rules: Each bot move: 95% chance Stockfish top move, 5% chance a 'Martin' move (Martin 250-style weak move); random, not revealed.
